title: R-U Fishing Yet Charters
specs: See numerous species of birds including herons, egrets, ibis, osprey, and occasional bald eagle
Often see alligators, crocodiles, manatees, and porpoises while fishing
Target species include snook, redfish, sea trout, bonefish, tarpon, and permit
No fishing in heavy rain or lightning storms; sometimes fish in windy conditions
19 Foot Skiff rates are for 2 people; a third person can be added for $100
22 Bayboat rates are for 3 adults or 2 adults and 2 children

blurb: Guests fish in the local backcountry and flats targeting various species including snook, redfish, sea trout, bonefish, tarpon, and permit. The experience includes sighting local wildlife such as birds, alligators, crocodiles, manatees, and porpoises. Trips are conducted on either a 19-foot skiff or a 22-foot bayboat.
extraNote: Cancellation policy: within 2 weeks full pay; 2 weeks to a month out $200 per trip · Postcard Inn Beach Resort and Marina at Holiday Isle, Guides Dock
